A preservation and organization account

In its undated website account, the Nause-Waiwash Band of Indians describes a late-1980s effort to preserve local history, culture and traditions. The account connects that effort to conversations with elders and organization of the named band. This is the institution’s account; its wider historical and institutional relationships remain unresolved.
